WITH latest_10k AS (
    SELECT 
        f.cik,
        f.adsh,
        f.fiscal_year,
        f.filed_date
    FROM filings f
    WHERE f.form = '10-K' 
        AND f.fiscal_period = 'FY'
        AND f.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.cik ORDER BY f.fiscal_year DESC, f.filed_date DESC) = 1
),
goodwill_facts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ff.cik,
        ff.value,
        ff.tag
    FROM financial_facts ff
    INNER JOIN latest_10k l ON ff.adsh = l.adsh
    WHERE ff.tag LIKE '%Goodwill%'

        AND ff.value > 30000000000
)

WITH companies_with_both_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r1.cik, r1.name
    FROM v_revenue r1
    WHERE r1.fiscal_year = 2024
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM v_revenue r2 
        WHERE r2.cik = r1.cik 
        AND r2.fiscal_year = 2025
    )
),
revenue_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cik,
        c.name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.fiscal_year = 2024 THEN r.value END) AS revenue_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.fiscal_year = 2025 THEN r.value END) AS revenue_2025
    FROM companies_with_both_years c
    JOIN v_revenue r ON c.cik = r.cik
    WHERE r.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY c.cik, c.name
),
growth_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        CASE 
            WHEN revenue_2024 > 0 THEN ((revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) / revenue_2024) * 100
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS growth_percentage
    FROM revenue_by_year
    WHERE revenue_2024 IS NOT NULL AND revenue_2025 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name
FROM growth_calculation
WHERE growth_percentage = (SELECT MAX(growth_percentage) FROM growth_calculation)
